function.strangestElement: A 21 m nursery is implausibly large as one room; four connected domestic spaces address that scale. The oversized original 3 m double doors remain to preserve gameplay.
function.notes: Nursery Function-stage layout, opening schedule and three prop reference designs. Local Blender authoring with no paid Meshy jobs. Form and Runtime approval are not implied.

form.strangestElement: The former empty 21 m chamber is now four rooms. The native keeper uses the existing zombie asset; a bespoke human corpse and mother character remain separate art work.
form.notes: Local Blender Form proposal; original human Function approval retained. No final game export, integration or deployment. Corrected support heights, shortened bed, added animation roots, restored source materials, and opened lamp shades.

runtime.strangestElement: The keeper still uses the existing credited creature asset; a bespoke corpse and mother character are outside this room upgrade.
runtime.notes: Integrated and tested local 0.8.1 candidate. Form-approved layout preserved; runtime clearance fixes documented in final-report.json. Human Runtime approval remains separate from the executed technical checks.
